name: su_Pt10_TiO2a101
title: Pt10 / anatase TiO2(101)
description: Pt10 on a frozen 3-layer stoichiometric anatase TiO2(101) slab (oblique 15.2 x 15.3 A cell, 216 atoms; NEP89 a = 3.819 A, c = 9.296 A vs exp. 3.785, 9.514 A), the majority facet of anatase-supported Pt photo- and thermal catalysts. The NEP89 putative GM is a 3D Pt5+5 bilayer anchored on the terrace by 5-fold Ti (Pt-Ti 2.49-2.65 A) and 2-fold O (Pt-O 2.09 A), consistent with the strong Pt binding on anatase(101) terraces found by DFT and STM (Gong et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 130, 370 (2008)). Caveats: NEP89 Pt-Ti contacts are short (2.76 A in Pt3Ti), NEP89 is charge-neutral and its anatase c axis is 2.3% too short.
